concepts.gloss_en: baki — one who is expert/proficient (in halakha or spiritual practice)
bakei — gnats (Aramaic, from the Talmudic dictum about the ox driving away gnats)

reason_for_human: These are two different words that happen to share the consonantal skeleton בקי. Occurrence 2960 is בָּקִי 'expert' (Hebrew, aspect of Name YBK), while occurrence 3600 is בָּקֵי 'gnats' — an Aramaic word inside the Talmudic saying 'they dwell in marshes and need to drive away gnats,' which Reb Nachman then puns on as YBK. Different vocalization and different meaning, so they must stay split.
